full_script: [thoughtful] Diez huecos, diez palabras. ¿Hasta dónde llegas? I used to live in Lima. Did you use to play sports? She used to have long hair. Ahora, nivel intermedio. I didn't use to like coffee. We would go fishing every summer. I'm used to living alone. You'll get used to waking early. Y ahora, nivel experto. There used to be a park here. I can't get used to the noise. He's not what he used to be. Llegar a la tres es nivel básico; a la siete, intermedio; y a la diez, experto. [happy] ¿Cuántas acertaste? Déjame tu número abajo.
